summary: Iteration 102 – Member Recruitment tracking. Backend pytest (test_iteration102_recruitment.py) 12/12 pass. Frontend end-to-end verified via Playwright: admin tab, add/edit/delete flow, per-recruit search + clear, CSV template/import (dry_run preview showing 'READY/SKIP/ERROR' correctly), Reports → Recruitment tab with 4 sub-views (entries/by_recruiter/by_chapter/by_month) + year/period/chapter filters + Export CSV, and homepage Top Recruiters Leader Board widget with Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4/2026 period switcher and Top Chapters / Top Recruiters sub-tabs. Backend permission API confirms 'recruitment' is present in all 4 admin_role tab sets (full, membership_manager, operations_manager, governor_manager).

minor.issue: Documented Membership Manager credential mm.tx@clubhaven.app logs in successfully but /auth/me reports role='member' admin_role=None, so /admin/permissions returns 403 and the recruitment tab is not exposed for that account. Not a recruitment feature bug — the seed for mm.tx has drifted from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. governor.tx@clubhaven.app works correctly and shows 'recruitment' in its tabs.

action_items: OPTIONAL: reseed mm.tx@clubhaven.app so its role='admin' + admin_role='membership_manager' (so Membership Manager coverage in the recruitment access-control matrix is testable end-to-end). Feature itself is fine — governor_manager + admin already validated.

NOTE for future test agents: /reports is not a standalone route — the Reports view is mounted inside /admin under data-testid=admin-tab-reports. Reach the Recruitment sub-tab via /admin → Reports tab → reports-tab-recruitment.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: recruitment.py cleanly denormalizes recruiter_name/email + recruit_name/email + chapter_name so list/report/leaderboard don't need $lookup — good.
CSV import handles email-first / full_name fallback, and the dry_run preview surface a per-row status (READY / SKIP / ERROR) with human-readable reason — verified live.
Leaderboard period=q3 correctly labels 'Q3 2026' with a Jul 1 – Sep 30 window; period=year labels '2026'.
test_credentials: admin@clubhaven.app / Admin123! → works. governor.tx@clubhaven.app / Governor123! → works (chapter-scoped, sees recruitment). mm.tx@clubhaven.app / MemMgr123! → logs in but currently seeded as role=member (recruitment tab hidden). Fix seed or ignore for feature validation.
seed_data_creation: Test-only members created via pytest fixture with prefix 'qa_iter102_' + timestamp on @qatest.example domain; per-test cleanup wipes their recruitment rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported into the shell env before running pytest — otherwise BASE falls back to http://localhost:8001 and the login cookies (Secure; SameSite=none) attach differently. Use `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2)` then pytest. Recruitment feature is stable; if regressions appear, first check /api/admin/permissions.tabs contains 'recruitment' for the tested admin_role.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs found. Initial pytest 401 was caused by missing REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in shell env making BASE default to localhost:8001; exporting the env value from frontend/.env resolved it and all 12 tests pass.
